      Travel to Switzerland

      Experience the Scenic Elegance of Switzerland with Saudia Airlines

      Unveil a world of alpine wonders and timeless charm where snow-capped peaks meet turquoise lakes. Switzerland invites you to explore its pristine landscapes and sophisticated cities through experiences that stir the soul. Fly with Saudia Airlines to begin your elevated journey toward the heart of the Swiss Alps.


      1. Savor Authentic Alpine Cheese

      Visit a high-altitude dairy to taste the true essence of the mountains. Watch how centuries of tradition turn fresh milk into world-renowned Gruyere or Appenzeller for a savory mountain treat.


      2. Board Iconic Scenic Trains

      Glide through the clouds on the Glacier Express or Bernina Express. These architectural marvels offer panoramic views of deep valleys and soaring summits from the comfort of your seat.


      3. Craft Your Own Chocolate

      Step into the world of master chocolatiers to create your own sweet masterpiece. Learn the secrets of Swiss tempering and smooth ganache that have made this nation the world's chocolate capital.


      4. Explore Charming Mountain Villages

      Stroll through car-free gems like Zermatt or Wengen. Admire flower-decked wooden chalets and breathe in the crisp air as you experience a slower, more beautiful pace of life.


      5. Hike Breathtaking Alpine Trails

      Lace up your boots for a trek through meadows bursting with wildflowers. From easy strolls to challenging climbs, every path rewards you with views that feel like a living postcard.


      6. Discover Historic Watchmaking Heritage

      Explore the workshops of the Jura Mountains where precision meets art. See how dedicated craftsmen assemble intricate movements that keep the world on time with unparalleled Swiss accuracy.


      7. Indulge In Traditional Fondue

      Gather around a bubbling pot of melted cheese in a cozy mountain hut. Dip crusty bread into this communal feast and enjoy a heartwarming meal that defines Swiss hospitality.


      8. Cruise Pristine Crystal Lakes

      Board a historic paddle steamer on Lake Lucerne or Lake Geneva. Feel the cool breeze as you sail past grand villas and steep cliffs reflecting in the deep blue water.


      9. Visit Traditional Show Dairies

      Watch the fascinating process of cheese-making in modern facilities that honor old-world methods. Engage with local producers and see how they maintain the highest standards of quality and flavor.


      10. Experience Seasonal Alpine Festivals

      Join the locals for the colorful Desalpe as cows descend from summer pastures decorated with flowers. Celebrate the changing seasons with folk music and vibrant traditions that bring Swiss history to life.

      Scroll to view more →

      Cities You Should Visit When Traveling to Switzerland

      1. Zurich

      Dive into a vibrant metropolis where Alpine beauty meets urban sophistication. Wander through the cobblestone charm of the Old Town, indulge in world-class shopping on Bahnhofstrasse, and find your zen by the shimmering waters of Lake Zurich. From iconic art galleries to the sweetness of the Lindt Home of Chocolate, every corner offers a new discovery in this pristine city of "Swiss Perfection."


      2. Geneva

      Experience the height of elegance in the global capital of diplomacy. Admire the majestic Jet d'Eau as it dances against the backdrop of the Alps and Jura Mountains, then lose yourself in the historic winding streets of the old town. Whether you are exploring the cutting-edge science at CERN or savoring refined French influence along the lakeside promenade, Geneva promises a stay filled with cosmopolitan flair and serene natural beauty.
